WHAT: Filter out common style words that add noise to Vinted searches before building the query string
WHY: 'leather low top lace up sneakers' → 9 results. 'leather low top sneakers' → 20 results. 'Lace up' is assumed for all sneakers and filtering on it cuts results dramatically.
HOW: Before appending style to query, strip: ['lace up', 'slip on', 'minimalist', 'classic', 'casual', 'slim fit', 'regular fit', 'standard fit']
WHERE: lib/build-query.ts, in the style processing step
GOTCHA: Also deduplicate words — if material='leather' and style='leather low top', don't output 'leather leather low top'. Strip material words from style string before appending.
